rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: In prior iterations scanner.tsx processCode() on the CODE-MATCH branch (idx !== -1) executed `setStops(prev => prev.map(...s, status: 'entregue' as const, timestamp: ...))` — meaning a single camera scan (or 4-second-debounced repeat) would mutate the stop status to 'entregue' and persist via saveRoute() before the driver had a chance to physically deliver the package. Users delivering by hand would scan to hear the parada number and unintentionally auto-complete the stop. FIX: processCode CODE-MATCH branch now only calls speakStop(seq) + setLastScanned + setFeedback (msg '📦 Parada N', color=COLORS.primary) — no more setStops/saveRoute on scan. confirmFallback (used when the scanned code isn't yet in the route) still adopts the code onto the next pending stop via `{ ...s, codigo: scannedCode }` BUT no longer flips status/timestamp — the stop stays 'pendente' until the driver taps 'Entregue' on the route card. Modal was also updated: the fallback confirm button now reads literal 'OK' (orange, positioned second) and the cancel button reads 'Cancelar' (gray, first), matching the user's screenshot request.
